hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: Pisamira, a Tucanoan language of the Eastern Eastern Tucanoan II subgroup (**hh:hv:Chacon:Proto-Tukanoan**), is missing in E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 as a separate language (**hh:s:dePerez:Pisamira**). Pisamira is listed under Tucano [tuo] which is of the Eastern Eastern Tucanoan I subgroup and not at all intelligible to Pisamira (**hh:hv:Chacon:Proto-Tukanoan**, **hh:s:dePerez:Pisamira**). See also: Tucano [tuo].
